method: Read-only primary-source inspection and checksum comparison. No downloaded payload was executed.

referenceHost.status: Direct browser/search access unavailable during research; upstream Nazky and Kameleon GitHub source used instead.

facts: Host explicitly targets PS4 firmware 9.00.
Each imported BZIP2 filename is mapped by a named menu function to the exact GTA V or RDR2 game update.
Upstream loadPayloadDataBz2 decompresses the binary before loading it. The site import performs only this decompression, never execution.
No regional CUSA list is supplied for these twelve menu builds.
Requests /status with POST for 127.0.0.1, otherwise GET.
Requires parsed JSON status equal to ready.
POSTs the raw downloaded ArrayBuffer to http://PS4IP:9090, with no extra framing or explicit custom headers.
The upstream success callback checks HTTP status 200, not the body. Delivery acceptance does not prove game injection.
CORS policy is not established by the client source; browser transport must handle connection, mixed-content and CORS failures honestly.
Published asset RedDead2.60FPS_v2.0.elf has upstream SHA-256 646ecb71e80415ab9d9c651539451d38ee0052a5997f7ef7504a42932c7f8261.
PS5 runtime patch for the PS4 RDR2 game at clean update 1.32.
Supported game title IDs are CUSA08519, CUSA03041 and CUSA08568.
Load the ELF before starting the game; wait for ready then start within 10 minutes.
Requires jailbroken PS5 and elfldr. No full validated PS5 firmware list is published; references to 8.40 and 13.60 are not treated as a universal support range.
Upstream declares GPL redistribution terms and retains the original KurohaXR/Arman Jafari MIT notice plus ps5debug-NG GPL component notice.
Local metadata preserves the complete upstream LICENSE and README unchanged; catalog links corresponding tagged source.

sources.verification: Read-only inspection of official tagged source, payload_readhttp and on_connection.
facts: HTTP GET port9021 accepts a uri parameter naming the console-reachable ELF URL.
The HTTP response declares Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
HTTP200 is written before uri_get_content downloads the ELF and before payload_spawn executes it, so request acceptance must not be labelled execution success.
Use the actual published or LAN hosting origin for native URL loading. A computer-only 127.0.0.1 source URL is not reachable from the PS5.

binaryInspection.interpretation: Raw PS4 payload BIN; not an ELF or a GoldHEN PRX plugin. Static byte inspection only; never executed.
